s: makAraH । sa tu paYcaviMSatitamavyaYjanavarRaH । asyoccAraRasTAnamozWaH । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ (“upUpaDmAnIyAnAmozWO .” iti sidDAntakOmudI ॥) asya svarUpaM yaTA, -- “makAraM SfRu cArvvaNgi ! svayaM paramakuRqalI । taruRAdityasaNkASaM caturvvargapradAyakam ॥ paYcadevamayaM varRaM paYcaprARamayaM sadA .” iti kAmaDenutantram ॥ (vaNgIyAkzarEH) asya leKanaprakAraH । yaTA, -- “UrdDvADaHkramato reKA vAme vakrA tu kuRqalI । punaScADogatA sEva tata UrdDvagatA punaH । brahmA SamBuSca vizRuSca kramaSastAsu tizWati ॥” asya DyAnaM yaTA, -- “kfzRAM daSaBujAM BImAM pItalohitalocanAm । kfzRAmbaraDarAM nityAM DarmmakAmArTamokzadAm । evaM DyAtvA makArantu tanmantraM daSaDA japet ॥” tatpraRAmamantro yaTA, -- “triSaktisahitaM varRaM tribindusahitaM sadA । AtmAditattvasaMyuktaM hfdisTaM praRamAmyaham ॥” iti varRodDAratantram ॥ tasya nAmAni । “maH kAlI kleSitaH kAlA mahAkAlo mahAntakaH । vEkuRWo vasuDA candrI raviH puruzarAjakaH ॥ kAlaBadro jayA meDA viSvadA dIptasaMjYakaH । jaWaraYca BramA mAnaM lakzmIrmAtograbanDanO ॥ vizaM Sivo mahAvIraH SaSipraBA janeSvaraH । pramattaH priyasU rudraH sarvvANgo vahnimaRqalam । mAtaNgamAlinI binduH SravaRA BaraTo viyat ॥” 36 ॥ iti tantroktavarRABiDAnam ॥
puM, (mAti nirmmAti jagaditi । mA + kaH .) SivaH । candramAH । brahmA । ityekAkzarakozaH ॥ yamaH । samayaH । vizam । maDusUdanaH । iti medinI । me, 1 ॥

m: 3. म base of the 1st pers. pron. in acc. sg. माम् or मा
gen. मम or मे (for the enclitic forms, cf. Pāṇ. viii, 1, 22 &c.)
म [cf. s. मद्; Zd. ma; Gk. ἐ-μέ, μέ, Lat. me, mihi &c.]
4. म (connected with √ 3. मा) m. time, L.
(in music) N. of the 4th note of the scale (abbreviated for मध्यम)
N. of various gods (of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and Yama), L.
a: मः — 1 Time. --2 Poison. --3 A magical formula. --4 The moon. --5 N. of Brahman. --6 Of Viṣṇu. --7 Of Śiva. --8 Of Yama. --9 (In prosody) A syllabic foot (गण) consisting of three long syllables. --10 N. of the fifth (मध्यम) note in music. --मं 1 Water. --2 Happiness, welfare.
